basic_profile.bio: A lifelong Star Wars enthusiast, I've been on Reddit for nearly a decade, often diving deep into discussions about film history and memorabilia. Based in San Francisco, I work as a freelance researcher focusing on popular culture artifacts. I enjoy visiting museums and attending auctions to learn more about the film industry's forgotten treasures. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work, and I often spend weekends exploring local exhibits and conventions. Currently single, I value my independence and the freedom to explore my passions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise spans across film history with a particular focus on science fiction memorabilia. With a degree in Film Studies and years of experience in archival research, I've honed my skills through self-study and attending numerous conventions and exhibitions. I often share insights on how props and costumes are preserved and their significance in cultural history.
